metrics.summary: Fixed `NameAliasMixin.get_real_name()` in sqlparse/sql.py. It previously stopped at the *first* dot, so for `db.schema.tbl.col` it returned `schema`. The fix iterates `token_next_by(m=(T.Punctuation, '.'), idx=...)` to advance past every dot, remembering the last valid dot index, then calls `_get_first_name(dot_idx, real_name=True)` on the tokens after the last dot. Verified: `db.schema.tbl.col` → real name `col`, `x.y.z AS w` → real `z`/alias `w`, `a.b` → `b`, `x` → `x`, `mydb.sch.func(1)` → `func`, `get_parent_name()` still returns `db`. Full test suite passes (489 passed, 2 xfailed, 1 xpassed — same as before the change).
